the mechanisms of bacterial infections in the lung.
the role of β1-integrines in CF airway epithelial cells, and the consequences of their accumulation in these cells for bacterial infections.
the role of β1-integrine and ceramide accumulation in CF airway epithelia and their role in the pathogenesis of CF-associated lung disease.
